card.timing: A fresh closed-bar crossing at t; B uses its latest EXPECTED fully closed source bar ending floor(t/timeframeMs)*timeframeMs. Missing/null expected bar blocks, never fall back to an older one. Source availableAt <= t. Model historical zero publication lag and a separate +60s execution delay for BOTH entries and exits. Freeze A/B at t; do not refresh B while entry is pending. No execution-minute H/L/C at the decision.
card.inventory: One independent position per definition, fixed notional, no averaging or compounding. B false discards the A crossing permanently; occupied/pending crossings skipped, not queued. Timeout 12h from actual entry then exit delay. Preserve inherited same-timestamp event ordering. Mark cutoff inventory including hypothetical closing fee, never invent a completed close.
